name: v1.3.0.4
body:
- Updated ClownAssembler.
  - Much more robust, fixes various memory leaks and the like.
- Fixed 'Move Piece to Front' (and similar actions) being usable when they should not be (#12).

name: v1.3.0.3
body: - Fixed compatibility with assembly data which uses CRLF line endings.

name: v1.3.0.2
body:
- Fixed background colour-matching being too strict.
- Fixed files, whose paths contain non-ASCII characters, being unable to load or be saved.

name: v1.3.0.1
body: - Fixed MapMacros sometimes not being output when they should have been.

name: v1.3
body:
- Supports mappings from the 2005 Hivebrain _Sonic 1_ disassembly and older versions of [the Git _Sonic & Knuckles_ disassembly](https://github.com/sonicretro/skdisasm).
- States now record all settings.
- Pattern load cues are disabled when new mappings are loaded.
- Sprite importing is disabled when no sprite is selected.
- Current file dialogue directory is preserved across executions.
- Fixed error message box appearing when closing a file dialogue without selecting a file.

Read about the mappings parser overhaul on [my blog](https://clownacy.wordpress.com/2025/08/07/clownmaped-v1-3/)!

name: v1.2.0.2
body:
- Fixed bugs that would occur when...
  - Importing sprite data over sprites that use non-existent tiles.
  - Deleting tiles.
  - Duplicating the final tile(s).

name: v1.2.0.1
body: - Fixed inability to load compressed data.

name: v1.2
body:
- Settings and sprite data are no longer lost when the program is closed.
- Up to 9 'save states' can be made, allowing work to be saved and resumed later.
- Tiles can be oriented vertically.
- Assembler error output is shown when assembly data fails to be loaded.

name: v1.1.2
body:
## General changes
- Fixed cycling backwards through sprite pieces getting stuck at piece 0.
- Fixed the selected sprite piece not being visually highlighted.
- The editor now gracefully recovers when loading invalid mappings and DPLCs.
- Sprite importing now only matches the background colour if it is exact.
- Sprite importing now allows bitmaps which do not mark their unbounded areas.

## Technical changes
- Added support for Qt 6.
- Made compatible with Qt 5.12.
- Offloaded asset processing to [the libsonassmd library](https://github.com/Clownacy/libsonassmd).
- Added an AppImage build.
- Switched to the static MSVC runtime library, avoiding the need for users to install any redistributables.

name: v1.1.1
body:
* Saving tiles/palettes/mappings/DPLCs no longer requires permission to overwrite existing files.
* Non-MapMacro mappings/DPLCs no longer use local labels, to improve compatibility with old disassemblies.
* Tiles can now be saved in assembly format.

name: v1.1
body:
* Fixed selected sprite piece not incrementing.
* Fixed generated assembly mappings using too many leading zeroes for the sprite size value.
* Added support for loading and saving in the MapMacros format (enabled by default).

name: v1.0.1
body:
- More keyboard shortcuts have been added to account for alternate keyboard layouts. This particularly benefits German keyboard layouts, where the '[' and ']' keys are far less accessible. '[' and ']' have been bound to '8' and '9', and ';' and ''' have been bound to '6' and '7'.
- File dialogs now support more file extensions ('.unc', '.nem', etc.).

name: v1.0
body: The initial release. While not yet at feature-parity with SonMapEd, this version should provide all of the essentials.
